bio:
Ducky Dynamo

*Monthly*

Featured on NPR and MPT and honored by Baltimore's Mayor for cultural
contributions, Ducky Dynamo's party antics have led her to become a
mainstay in the hearts of partygoers near and far. She’s toured
through the country and across our borders, bringing Baltimore Club
culture’s sound to all within earshot. A true ambassador of her city's
sonic energy and spirit, she continues to push her impact, embarking
on the production and fervent spinning of infectious tracks infused
with the Baltimore Club Sound. At home, Ducky Dynamo has cemented
herself as a staple and trendsetter in Baltimore Club Culture: When
times were tough for the genre, Ducky fought valiantly for it and
became the bridge between the older generation and newer generations
of fans, producers, dancers, and DJs.
title: Ducky Dynamo
